categories.name: Pole Dance & Exotic
categories.subtitle: Strength, flexibility and confidence on the pole

cards.title: Pole Dancing
cards.description: Our core Pole Dance class. Build full-body strength and learn skills step by step, with no previous experience required.

cards.title: Exotic Dance
cards.description: Flowing movement, floorwork and personal style set to music. Ideal if you want a more expressive side of pole.

categories.name: Aerial Dance
categories.subtitle: Sling, Hoop, Pole and the feeling of flight

cards.title: Aerial Sling & Aerial Hoop (Lyra)
cards.description: Build core and upper-body strength, learn skills on fabric or hoop and explore aerial movement with structured guidance.

cards.title: Aerial Pole
cards.description: Private class by appointment for 1–3 people, combining pole and aerial elements in a more personalised setting.

cards.title: Bungee Fitness
cards.description: A workout using a specialised bungee harness that lets you move dynamically through the air. Available by appointment for 1–5 people, with closed regular groups also possible.

categories.name: Flexibility
categories.subtitle: A foundation for your other classes

cards.title: Flexibility
cards.description: Focused flexibility training that supports Pole, Aerial and partner dance.

cards.title: Salsa
cards.description: Lively rhythms, partnerwork and Caribbean energy. You do not need to bring a partner to start.

cards.title: Bachata
cards.description: A slower, more sensual partner dance with emphasis on connection, musicality and body movement.

cards.title: Salsa Ladies Style
cards.description: A ladies styling team focused on choreography, performances and selected dance festival appearances.

categories.name: High Heels (Commercial)
categories.subtitle: Heels choreography with a modern commercial style

cards.title: High Heels Commercial
cards.description: Heels choreography with contemporary commercial influences, working on balance, posture and confidence.

categories.name: Family & Kids
categories.subtitle: Two new classes for families and younger students

cards.title: Mama & Baby
cards.description: Dance and movement with a baby carrier for mums and babies from 3 months to 2 years. Medical or midwife approval and a suitable carrier are required.
cards.image_alt: Mama & Baby dance class with baby carriers at Step Up Dance Studio in Thessaloniki

cards.title: Acro Kids
cards.description: Aerial Acrobatics for children in a safe, guided environment, with two age groups: 6–12 and 13–17.
